expectedUsable: Tabbing through the contact form visits fields in their visual/reading order (first name, last name, email, reason, message, submit).

violations.expectedFix: Remove all positive tabindex attributes (tabindex="1".."6") and rely on DOM order for a natural focus sequence; use tabindex="0"/"-1" only where genuinely needed.
violations.notes: Positive tabindex values scramble keyboard order to first->message->last->email->reason->submit. axe's tabindex heuristic is a best-practice rule (not a WCAG success criterion), so the WCAG-conformance scan reports zero violations while 2.4.3 Focus Order is actually broken.
